# Widgets, properties, styles and actions

<!-- Generated by tools/skill/gen_reference.js from tools/designer/renderer/js/schema.js. Do not edit by hand. -->

Only what is listed here exists. A key that is not listed is silently ignored by the runtime.
How to use bindings, actions, popups and the special widgets (alarm list, trend, recipe table): binding-and-actions.md.

## Widget types (`"type"`)

"Created with" is what the designer writes for a new widget: sensible default sizes. Every widget also takes the common keys below.

| type | what | own properties | created with |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `panel` | Panel | `children` (array of widgets) | `{"w":200,"h":120}` |
| `label` | Label | `text` (text), `long_mode` (`wrap` / `dots` / `scroll` / `circular` / `clip`) | `{"text":"Label"}` |
| `button` | Button | `text` (text), `checkable` (true / false) | `{"text":"Button"}` |
| `switch` | Switch | `checked` (true / false) | - |
| `checkbox` | Checkbox | `text` (text), `checked` (true / false) | `{"text":"Check"}` |
| `slider` | Slider | `min` (number), `max` (number), `value` (number) | `{"w":200,"min":0,"max":100}` |
| `bar` | Bar | `min` (number), `max` (number), `value` (number) | `{"w":200,"h":10,"min":0,"max":100}` |
| `arc` | Arc | `min` (number), `max` (number), `value` (number), `start_angle` (number), `end_angle` (number), `rotation` (number), `adjustable` (true / false) | `{"w":130,"h":130,"min":0,"max":100}` |
| `led` | LED | `color` (color), `on` (true / false) | `{"w":26,"h":26,"color":"#4caf50"}` |
| `dropdown` | Dropdown | `options` (array of texts), `selected` (number) | `{"w":160,"options":["Option 1","Option 2","Option 3"]}` |
| `roller` | Roller | `options` (array of texts), `selected` (number), `visible_rows` (number), `infinite` (true / false) | `{"w":120,"options":["One","Two","Three"],"visible_rows":3}` |
| `textarea` | Text area | `text` (text), `placeholder` (text), `one_line` (true / false), `password` (true / false), `max_length` (number), `accepted_chars` (text) | `{"w":200,"one_line":true,"placeholder":"type here"}` |
| `numeric_display` | Numeric display | `input` (true / false), `decimals` (number), `format` (text), `unit` (text), `min` (number), `max` (number), `placeholder` (text), `accepted_chars` (text) | `{"w":120,"decimals":1}` |
| `text_display` | Text display | `input` (true / false), `text` (text), `placeholder` (text), `max_length` (number), `accepted_chars` (text), `one_line` (true / false) | `{"w":160}` |
| `password_display` | Password input | `input` (true / false), `placeholder` (text), `max_length` (number), `accepted_chars` (text) | `{"w":160,"max_length":8}` |
| `image` | Image | `src` (image path), `fit` (`contain` / `stretch` / `tile` / `center`), `zoom` (number), `rotation` (number) | - |
| `chart` | Chart | `chart_type` (`line` / `bar` / `scatter`), `points` (number), `min` (number), `max` (number), `sample_ms` (number), `hdiv` (number), `vdiv` (number), `update_mode` (`shift` / `circular`), `series` (`[{ "tag", "color", "scale" }]`) | `{"w":300,"h":160,"chart_type":"line","points":100,"min":0,"max":100,"sample_ms":500,"hdiv":3,"vdiv":5,"series":[]}` |
| `spinner` | Spinner | `time` (number), `angle` (number) | `{"w":60,"h":60}` |
| `keyboard` | Keyboard | - | `{"align":"bottom_mid","w":"100%","h":"45%"}` |
| `trend` | Trend | `group` (data log group name), `tags` (array of texts), `range_s` (number), `min` (number), `max` (number), `buckets` (number), `refresh_ms` (number), `tags` items may be `{ "tag", "color" }`; `labels` (`{ "now" }`) | `{"w":"100%","h":300,"range_s":3600}` |
| `recipe_table` | Recipe table | `book` (recipe book name), `row_height` (number), `labels` (object of texts) | `{"w":"100%","h":300}` |
| `line` | Line | `points` ([[x, y], ...]) | `{"points":[[0,0],[120,60]]}` |
| `meter` | Meter | `min` (number), `max` (number), `value` (number), `angle` (number), `ticks` (number), `major_every` (number), `decimals` (number), `unit` (text), `show_value` (true / false), `needle_color` (color), `zones` (`[ { "from": 80, "to": 100, "color": "#e53935" } ]`: parts of the scale in a colour) | `{"w":200,"h":200,"min":0,"max":100}` |
| `log_view` | Log view | `source` (`system` / `operation` / `data`), `group` (data log group name), `columns` (array of texts), `rows` (number), `days` (number), `min_level` (`info` / `warn` / `error`), `filter` (true / false), `filter_tag` (tag name), `refresh_ms` (number), `labels` (object of texts: `empty` and the titles of the columns), `widths` (`{ "time": 150 }`, pixels) | `{"w":"100%","h":300,"source":"system"}` |
| `alarm_list` | Alarm list | `mode` (`current` / `history`), `rows` (number), `row_height` (number), `columns` (array of texts), `ack_on_tap` (true / false), `severity` (text), `days` (number), `labels` (object of texts) | `{"w":"100%","h":240,"ack_on_tap":true}` |
| `alarm_banner` | Alarm banner | `blink` (true / false), `ack_on_tap` (true / false), `labels` (object of texts) | `{"w":"100%","h":36}` |

A short `"bind": "tag"` binds this property of each type:

`switch` → `checked`, `checkbox` → `checked`, `button` → `checked`, `slider` → `value`, `arc` → `value`, `dropdown` → `value`, `roller` → `value`, `bar` → `value`, `label` → `text`, `led` → `on`, `textarea` → `text`, `image` → `src`, `spinner` → `visible`, `panel` → `visible`, `numeric_display` → `value`, `text_display` → `text`, `password_display` → `text`

## Common keys of every widget

| key | value |
| --- | --- |
| `x` | number |
| `y` | number |
| `w` | number (px), `"50%"`, `"content"`, `"full"` |
| `h` | number (px), `"50%"`, `"content"`, `"full"` |
| `align` | `top_left` / `top_mid` / `top_right` / `left_mid` / `center` / `right_mid` / `bottom_left` / `bottom_mid` / `bottom_right` |
| `hidden` | true / false |
| `disabled` | true / false |
| `clickable` | true / false |
| `scrollable` | true / false |
| `scrollbar` | `off` / `on` / `auto` / `active` |
| `flex` | `row` / `column` / `row_wrap` / `column_wrap` / `row_reverse` / `column_reverse` |
| `flex_main` | `start` / `center` / `end` / `space_between` / `space_around` / `space_evenly` |
| `flex_cross` | `start` / `center` / `end` |
| `flex_track` | `start` / `center` / `end` / `space_between` / `space_around` / `space_evenly` |
| `flex_grow` | number |
| `level` | number — minimum user level to operate this (0 / empty = everybody). Levels are defined on the Users tab |
| `level_deny` | `disable` / `hide` / `login` — for users below the level: disable (greyed out), hide, or login (looks normal; a touch opens the login screen) |

## Bindings (`"bind"`)

Kinds: `text`, `value`, `checked`, `on`, `visible`, `hidden`, `enabled`, `disabled`, `bg_color`, `text_color`, `options`, `src`.

Conditions: `eq`, `ne`, `gt`, `lt`, `ge`, `le`.

## Events and actions

Events: `on_click`, `on_press`, `on_release`, `on_long_press`, `on_long_press_repeat`, `on_change`, `on_ready`.

| action | keys |
| --- | --- |
| `set` | `tag` (tag name), `value` (text) |
| `toggle` | `tag` (tag name) |
| `inc` | `tag` (tag name), `by` (number) |
| `dec` | `tag` (tag name), `by` (number) |
| `goto` | `screen` (screen name), `anim` (animation) |
| `popup` | `screen` (screen name) |
| `close` | `screen` (screen name) |
| `language` | `lang` (text) |
| `back` | - |
| `reload` | - |
| `exit` | - |
| `restart` | `what` (`app` / `system`) |
| `system` | `anim` (animation) |
| `login` | - |
| `logout` | - |
| `call` | `fn` (text), `arg` (text) |
| `script` | `name` (script name), `code` (Lua code) |

An event can be put on any widget. A screen file itself takes `name`, `children`, the style objects, the common keys (`scrollable`, `flex` ..., `level`) and, for a popup, `popup`, `dim`, `w`, `h`, `x`, `y`, `align`. It takes no `bind` and no events.

Screen change animations (`"anim"`): `none`, `fade`, `slide_left`, `slide_right`, `slide_top`, `slide_bottom`, `over_left`, `over_right`, `move_left`, `move_right`, `move_top`, `move_bottom`.

## Animation (`"animate"` of any widget)

One object or a list. Keys: `preset`, `prop`, `from`, `to`, `time`, `delay`, `playback`, `repeat`, `path`, `when`, `files`.

| key | value |
| --- | --- |
| `prop` | `opa` / `x` / `y` / `w` / `h` / `rotation` / `zoom` / `bg_color` / `text_color` / `frames` |
| `preset` | `blink` / `pulse` / `spin` (fills in `prop`, `to`, `time` ...) |
| `path` | `linear` / `ease_in` / `ease_out` / `ease_in_out` / `step` |

How to use it: binding-and-actions.md.
